test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 17 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate homophone to fill in the blank.

The ointment will help to _____ the wound.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option (3)' **i.e.* 'heal'.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Heal**: To make or become healthy again (ठीक करना)

 
 
• **Example**: The ointment will help to heal the wound.&l
